rules.forest.title: Individual Forest Board
rules.forest.description: At the start, your Forest consists of a single Protective Tree. Over the course of the game, you can expand it by planting new Protective Trees. New Trees must always touch an already existing Tree.
rules.forest.resources: Completing particular rows or columns in your Forest instantly triggers a permanent Element bonus: 1 <0/>, 1 <1/>, 1 <2/> or 2 <3/> depending on the row or column. You can take it into account for your second Action and during the following turns.

rules.fragment.title: Fragment Tile
rules.fragment.description: Allows you to destroy a Varan or discard a Guardian Animal card you've just revealed, whatever its type, during the Guardian Animals phase. After playing a Fragment, you can either stop or continue drawing.
rules.fragment.get: Can be recovered through an Action, by moving on the Circle of Spirits or by planting a Protective Tree in a corner with 2 Fragment tiles.
rules.guardian-animal.title: Guardian Animal
rules.guardian-animal.description: During the Guardian Animals phase, you draw these cards to form your Help Line and build up a list of Actions with the accumulated resources.
rules.guardian-animal.get: To be able to buy them during the Action phase, you must have the required number of <0/> in your Help Line.
rules.varan.title: Varan Card
rules.varan.description: At the end of the turn, if your <0/> value is strictly less than the Fire power of the Circle of Spirits, you add as many Fire Varan cards to your discard pile as there are Fire tiles in the center of the Circle of Spirits.

rules.sacred-tree.description: The Spirit of Nature holding the Sacred Tree begins the turn. At the end of the turn, the Sacred Tree passes to the next player.
rules.spirit-nature.title: Spirit of Nature
rules.spirit-nature.description: You play as a Spirit of Nature trying to save the Forest and its Sacred Tree from Onibi's relentless attacks. Either by planting 12 different Protector Trees, harvesting 12 Sacred Flowers or putting out 12 Fires.
rules.victory-tile.title: Victory Tile
rules.victory-tile.description: When you start the game, you have 3 Victory tiles representing respectively a Fire, a Sacred Flower and a Protective Tree. These count towards your victory points. When you move around the Circle of Spirits and overtake a player, you can steal a Victory tile.
rules.protected-tree.type: There are three types of Guardian Animals: solitary represented by a black coin, gregarious represented by a white coin and neutral with no coin. A Gregarious symbol cancels out a Solitary symbol. If your Help Line contains strictly less than three Solitary symbols (not cancelled by Gregarious symbols), you can perform 2 different Actions. Otherwise, you can only perform one action
rules.help-line.title: Help Line
rules.help-line.description:
During this phase, all the Spirits of Nature play at the same time.

You draw and turn face up the Guardian Animal cards from your personal
draw stack, one after the other. You thus form the Guardian Animals Help Line.

You have already made up a team of 14 Guardian Animals, they are here
with you and they are ready to help at any time.

It is when you want to draw a card, and not when your draw stack is empty, that you
make a new one.

If you want to draw a new Guardian Animal card to place in your Help Line, but your draw
stack is empty, you then shuffle your discard stack to make a new draw stack.

You can stop drawing cards whenever you want.

However, if you reveal a card showing a third Solitary symbol, then you must stop drawing
cards. This card closes your Help Line.

tuto.pitch: In Living Forest, you play as a Spirit of Nature trying to save the Forest and its Sacred Tree from Onibi's relentless attacks.
tuto.goal:
There are three ways to win:
- by planting 12 different Protective Trees,
- by harvesting 12 Sacred Flowers,
- by putting out 12 Fires.
tuto.start: Here are your initial 14 Guardian Animal cards. Draw one and place it in your <0>Help Line</0> above.
tuto.animals: Guardian Animals give you Elements <0/>, <1/>, <2/>, <3/> and <4/> to support you in your actions.
tuto.sun: This Animal, for example, gives you 2 <0/>, which can be used to attract new Guardian Animals.
tuto.solitary:
This Animal has a <0>Solitary symbol</0> <1/>.
As long as you haven't revealed <0>3 Solitary symbols</0> <1/>, you can keep drawing.
tuto.pass:
You have a second <0>Solitary symbol</0> <1/>.
If you reveal a third one, <0>you'll lose one of your 2 Actions this turn</0>!
Click <0>Pass</0> in the header to stop drawing now.
tuto.simultaneous: Your opponents draw at the same time as you. When everyone has stopped drawing, the Action phase begins.
tuto.actions: During the Action phase, each player can play 2 Actions, starting with the player who has the Sacred Tree.
tuto.solitary.malus: If a player has <0>3 Solitary symbols</0> <1/><1/><1/>, they can only play one Action.
tuto.actions.list.wind: Move forward around the Circle of Spirits
tuto.actions.unique: You cannot perform the same Action twice.
tuto.action.sun:
Start by attracting Guardian Animals.
Here are the available Guardian Animals. Their cost is shown at the bottom right.
tuto.action.sun.rule: As you have {number} <0/>, you can take one or more Guardian Animals, for a total cost equal to or less than {number}.
tuto.action.sun.take: Take this Guardian Animal and place it at the top of your draw stack.
tuto.action.water:
Now use your second action to put out the Fire.
There is a value 2 Fire tile on the Sacred Tree.
tuto.action.water.rule: As you have {number} <0/>, you can put out one or more Fire tiles, for a total value equal to or less than {number}.
tuto.action.water.take: Put out the Fire by collecting the Fire tile next to your board. One of the 3 ways to win is to have 12 Fire tiles!
tuto.actions.opponent: It's your opponent's turn to play.
tuto.solitary.opponent: Your opponent has revealed 3 Solitary symbols! They can therefore perform only one Action.
tuto.opponent.sun: Your opponent is going to attract a Guardian Animal, and then a new round begins.
tuto.onibi.tree.attack:
At the end of the turn, Onibi attacks the Sacred Tree!
For each Guardian Animal attracted during the turn, a Fire tile is added to the Tree. The value of the flame depends on the level of the Guardian Animal attracted.
tuto.discard.animals:
Any Guardian Animals that helped you this turn go into your discard stack.
When your draw stack is empty, you can shuffle your discard stack to continue drawing.
tuto.sacred.tree: Finally, the Sacred Tree passes to the next player, who then plays their Actions first in the next round.
tuto.turn.2: It's a new turn! Draw a Guardian Animal and place it in your Help Line.
tuto.solitary.2:
You have 2 <0>Solitary symbols</0> <1/>.
Your starting deck has 5 solitary Animals. 2 are in your discard stack, 2 in your Help Line: one remains in your deck.
Click <0>Pass</0> in the header to avoid picking it.
tuto.opponent.played:
Your opponent has performed their Actions, now it's your turn.
Let's start by planting a Protective Tree!
tuto.trees:
These are the 12 Protective Trees that can be planted.
You only have 3 <0/>, so you can only choose one of the first 2.
tuto.trees.bonus:
Each Protective Tree grants a <0>permanent</0> bonus.
Trees must be planted here, next to an existing Tree.
tuto.lines.bonus: The middle row and 3 columns also offer a permanent bonus once completed.
tuto.tree.plant: Plant this Protective Tree, which gives 1 <0/>, here.
tuto.wind:
This is your second Action now.
You'll be able to move around the <0>Circle of Spirits</0>.
tuto.wind.move:
Spirits move clockwise, by a number of rocks equal to or less than your <0/>.
Use your 2 <0/> to move 2 steps.
tuto.wind.rules: Moving around the Circle of Spirits has 2 advantages.
tuto.wind.steal:
First of all, <0>if you overtake an opposing spirit, you'll take the Victory tile of your choice</0> from them.
There are 3 ways to win, and each of these tiles gives you 1 point out of the 12 needed to win.
tuto.wind.action:
Also, you immediately get a Bonus Action when you move!
Here, you've arrived on a rock with this Bonus Action: <0/>.
So you can attract new Guardian Animals.
tuto.sun.tree.bonus: You have {number} <0/>, since the permanent bonus from the Protective Tree you've just planted is effective immediately!
tuto.gregarious:
Take this Guardian Animal and place it on top of your draw stack.
It looks weak, but it has a <0>Gregarious symbol</0> <1/>. This symbol cancels out a <0>Solitary symbol</0> <2/>!
tuto.varan:
Here, the strength of the Fire is 4.
You have 2 <1/>, so you will receive 2 Varan cards.
Your opponent has 1 <1/>, so they will also receive 2 Varan cards.
tuto.varan.rule:
At the end of each turn, before adding Fire tiles to the Sacred Tree, we add up <0>the values</0> of the Fire tiles that have not been put out.
Each player with a value in <1/> less than the Fire power receives <0>one Varan per Fire tile</0> present in the center of the Circle of Spirits.
tuto.fragment.varan:
These Varans are a nuisance, but it's possible to get rid of them.
Here are the Fragment tiles. When you draw a Varan, if you have a Fragment in your possession, you can destroy the Varan with it.
tuto.fragment.other: If you use a Fragment tile on another Guardian Animal, it goes into your discard stack.
tuto.game.over:
The game ends if, at the end of a complete Action phase, one of the players has one of the following:
- <1/> 12 <0>different</0> Protective Trees.
- <2/> 12 Fire tiles.
- <3/> 12 Sacred Flowers <0>visible</0>.
tuto.complete:
At any time, you can click on the material for a reminder of the rules.
Now it's your turn to play!

header.gameover.summary:
The game ends <0>at the end of a complete Action phase</0> when a Spirit of Nature
has at least one of the following:

<1/>12 different Protective Trees: Count all the <0>different Trees</0> placed
on your Forest board, including the starting Tree, as well as all
Tree Victory tiles if you have any.
<2/> 12 Fires: Count the number of Fire tiles earned, not their value,
as well as any Fire Victory tiles if you have any.
<3/> 12 Sacred Flowers: Count the number of Flowers <0>visible</0> on your Help Line,
on your Forest board and among the Flower Victory tiles if you have any.

The Spirit ending the game wins. 
If more than one Spirit of Nature completes one of the three victory conditions at the end of a turn, 
then add up the values of their <0>three</0> victory conditions. 
The Spirit of Nature with the highest score wins.
